features.title: Proactive agent for one repository
features.what: It is a coding agent that lives with a single GitHub repository.
features.evidence_quote: dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

features.title: Listens, then opens a work item
features.what: A request for work becomes a work item with its own session and directory.
features.evidence_quote: It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory

features.title: Answers where the work was asked
features.what: The reply lands in the original conversation, often as a pull request.
features.evidence_quote: answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

features.title: Only acts when allowed
features.what: It acts when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it.
features.evidence_quote: it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result.

features.title: Setup walked through by an agent
features.what: Your own coding agent installs and configures it from the repo's setup guide.
features.evidence_quote: Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

features.title: Research code, not production
features.what: The repository says the code is a research prototype with possible bugs.
features.evidence_quote: Treat it as research code, not production-ready software.

risks.text: Research prototype: not an official DeepSeek product, and some designs from the paper are not implemented.
It runs as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness, so the harness is part of the setup.
